content:
anya: Heads-up from AM Jelena: SkylineAI (acct SK-900) disputed INV-2026-501. They executed a mid-month upgrade from Reserved-L -> Reserved-XL effective 2026-09-20 but our system billed XL for the full month AND charged a Priority-Burst add-on that was supposed to be waived per SOW. Can finance take?
kevin: Thanks. Do we have the signed SOW and amendment? Need exact effective date and waiver language.
am_jelena: Uploaded files: SKY_SOW_PRIORBURST_0901.pdf and SKY_AMEND_UPGRADE_0920.pdf. Amendment effective 2026-09-20. SOW clause says "first 250k overage tokens waived during migration window" and "priority-burst fee waived for first billing cycle post-upgrade."
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-501 lines:
```
Line1: RSRV-XL-2026, qty 1, period 2026-09-01 - 2026-09-30, amt $18,000
Line2: PRIOR-BURST-FEE, period 2026-09, amt $2,000
Line3: OVG-TOK, 600,000 tokens, amt $3,600
Total $23,600
```
kevin: Pricing reference: RSRV-L = $11,000/mo, RSRV-XL = $18,000/mo. Amendment effective 09-20 so correct reserved should be prorated: daily L = 11,000/30 = $366.67; daily XL = 18,000/30 = $600. Prorated reserved = 19 days L (Sep1-19) -> 19*366.67 = $6,966.73; 11 days XL (Sep20-30) -> 11*600 = $6,600. Total correct reserved = $13,566.73 (rounding cents). Billed reserved = $18,000. Reserved overcharge = $4,433.27.
marco: Confirming SOW: priority-burst fee should be waived for the post-upgrade invoice. Also first 250k tokens waived. Overage rate for customer = $0.006/token.
kevin: OVG calc: billed 600k * 0.006 = $3,600. Waiver 250k * 0.006 = $1,500. Net overage to customer = $2,100 but since they were billed $3,600 we need to credit $1,500 (waiver) plus the priority-burst $2,000.
anya: So suggested credit = reserved delta $4,433.27 + priority-burst $2,000 + token waiver $1,500 = $7,933.27. This exceeds $5k so requires manager approval.
dana: Reviewing attachments. SOW and amendment look valid and signed. Approving credit CM-2026-045 for $7,933.27. Approval id FIN-APP-8123. Approver note: documented concession per SOW and to preserve renewal.
kevin: Drafted CM-2026-045 for $7,933.27, accounting reason "Upgrade proration correction + SOW-prioritized waivers." Posting to AR pending processing.
ops-bot: SLA checks for SK-900 during Sep: No availability breach. Migration had transient 2-3 minute elevated latencies but no SLO breach. No SLA credit required.
skyline-billing: Customer request: please reissue invoice and send short explanation to our finance contact. They also requested an audit trail.
marco: Reissued invoice INV-2026-501-R1 reflecting CM-2026-045 (-$7,933.27). New total $15,666.73. Original invoice marked superseded. AR transaction TX-AR-100552 posted.
kevin: Attached audit package: amendment, SOW clause excerpt, metering CSV, CM, internal approval FIN-APP-8123. Logged billing case BILL-2026-450.
am_jelena: I will notify Skyline finance and attach INV-R1 + CM + audit. Draft note: "Per executed amendment and SOW we prorated your reserved commit and applied the agreed post-upgrade waivers. See attached CM-2026-045 and INV-2026-501-R1."
dana: Approved posting done. Please close once customer ACK.
anya: Customer acked: "Received, thank you for the quick correction." :thumbsup: Closing ticket after cash reconciliation.
